high_level_description: The image is an advertisement for a product that appears to be a wedge-shaped pillow designed for elevated support and comfort. The background is a soft pink with abstract yellow and white wavy lines, giving the image a gentle and calming feel. In the center of the image, there is a person lying on their side on the wedge pillow. They are wearing a sleeveless denim top and have dark hair. Their head is resting on the pillow, which is positioned under their upper back and shoulder area, elevating their upper body slightly.
